verified_claims: Pinned SaProfile and the explicit JSON profile readers do not define or populate permission/permission_acls; fixture and parser test provide source-level valid-profile controls.
startup_init parses optional permission and permission_acls arrays into service fields, passes them to NativeTokenInfoParams, obtains a token ID, and sets the process self token ID.

AccessToken native permission collection uses native ACL membership as an exception to the APL available-level filter for configured permission states; this concerns native service-token construction, not caller identity ACLs.
SAMgr CheckGetSAPermission is conditional on WITH_SELINUX and appears on acquisition/loading paths; this does not authorize each subsequent Pasteboard Binder method.
D52 profile/3701.xml has no permission fields; D52 init cfg has no permission arrays and refers to pasteboard_service.xml; source tree does not establish an install rename from 3701.xml.
